message.content:
There are several major online bookstores where you can find *To Kill a Mockingbird*:

| Online Bookstore | Typical Availability | Notes |
|------------------|----------------------|-------|
| **Amazon** | Widely available in paperback, hardcover, Kindle e‑book, and audiobook formats. | Often offers discounts, used copies, and Prime shipping. |
| **Barnes & Noble (BN.com)** | Available in paperback, hardcover, Nook e‑book, and audiobook. | BN’s “Nook” store sells e‑books; they also ship physical copies worldwide. |
| **Book Depository** | Free worldwide shipping on all formats (paperback, hardcover). | Great for international customers; no shipping fees. |
| **Books-A-Million (BAM)** | Paperback and hardcover options. | Offers free shipping on orders over $35. |
| **IndieBound** | Links to independent local bookstores that carry the title. | Supports local independent booksellers. |
| **Google Play Books / Apple Books** | Digital e‑book version. | Instant download; no shipping needed. |
| **Audible** | Audiobook version. | Subscription or one‑time purchase. |

If you’re looking for a specific format (e.g., paperback, hardcover, e‑book, audiobook) or a particular price point, let me know and I can help narrow it down or even add the item to your cart on a chosen platform!
message.reasoning: The user asks: "Which online bookstore sells 'To Kill a Mockingbird'?" They want to know which online bookstore sells that book. We can answer: Amazon, Barnes & Noble, Book Depository, etc. But we might also want to provide a link or mention that it's available on multiple platforms. The user didn't ask for a specific function call. So we just respond with text.
